description: This file defines the MultiMatch class used for macro matching and instantiation within Android navigation tools, including nested bindings and sub-macro handling.

classes.name: MultiMatch
classes.description: Represents a macro with sub-macros for pattern matching and instantiation in navigation macros.

classes.name: MultiMatch.Bindings
classes.description: Generic class for storing bindings and sub-bindings used during macro matching and instantiation.

methods.name: MultiMatch
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a PsiMethod macro.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a MultiMatch instance from a project and method definition string.

methods.name: addSubMacro
methods.description: Adds a sub-macro with a name and PsiMethod.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Matches a PsiElement against the macro pattern, returning bindings if successful.

methods.name: instantiate
methods.description: Instantiates the macro with given bindings, producing a string.
